difficulties.name: Easy
difficulties.description: Fewer enemies, weaker stats — good for learning routes.

difficulties.name: Normal
difficulties.description: Designed wave counts and baseline enemy tuning.

difficulties.name: Hard
difficulties.description: More enemies, +50% HP, +35% damage, higher dodge.

currencies.name: Gold
currencies.desc: Common loot coin — enemy drops, chests, vendors.

currencies.name: Gems
currencies.desc: Rare crystal — elite/boss rewards and premium shops.

nodes.name: Aegis
nodes.desc: Combine Guard + Bulwark into a true aegis.

nodes.name: Fortune
nodes.desc: Late-tree luck — skip until you have the points.

nodes.name: Crown
nodes.desc: Premium capstone. Costs 2 points per rank.

items.name: Damage Charm
items.desc: +5 attack damage for the rest of the run.

items.name: Scroll: Burn Infusion
items.desc: Reusable scroll. Slot onto any open weapon power slot. On hit, apply Burn stacks. At 5 stacks: Ignite.

dropTables.name: Boss Hoard
dropTables.desc: Boss shared table — high value, often guaranteed.

weapons.name: Service Pistol
weapons.desc: Starter semi-auto. Tapping beats spamming — free crits reward patience at hour ten.
weapons.fireIdentity: Semi auto. Any shot fired after a 0.4s pause is a guaranteed crit.

weapons.name: Hand Cannon
weapons.desc: Six shots, heavy damage, real knockback. Overpressure pierce after every reload.
weapons.fireIdentity: Every reload chambers one Overpressure round that pierces through a target and keeps going.

weapons.name: Machine Pistol
weapons.desc: Full auto on a heat gauge. Hold longer for more damage, pay with wider accuracy.
weapons.fireIdentity: Full auto on a heat gauge. Accuracy widens as heat climbs but damage climbs with it.

weapons.name: Paradox
weapons.desc: Time signature pistol. Every shot echoes 1.5s later at the same point in space.
weapons.fireIdentity: Every shot fires twice — once now, and an echo 1.5 seconds later at the exact same point in space.

weapons.name: Hourglass
weapons.desc: Time signature pistol. Accelerates aging; kills chamber a round instantly.
weapons.fireIdentity: Damage scales with how much health the target is missing. Kills chamber a round instantly, no reload.

weapons.name: Vanguard
weapons.desc: Class trait Suppression: eight continuous hits on the same target makes it flinch and cut its damage output. ARs keep a target locked down while the party sets up reactions.
weapons.fireIdentity: Full auto that tightens instead of widening. After one second of held fire, spread drops to zero and damage ramps.

weapons.name: Tribeam
weapons.desc: Class trait Suppression: eight continuous hits on the same target makes it flinch and cut its damage output. ARs keep a target locked down while the party sets up reactions.
weapons.fireIdentity: Three round burst. All three landing refunds the ammo and applies double element stacks.

weapons.name: Longshot
weapons.desc: Class trait Suppression: eight continuous hits on the same target makes it flinch and cut its damage output. ARs keep a target locked down while the party sets up reactions.
weapons.fireIdentity: Semi auto marksman. Damage scales upward with distance to target.

weapons.name: Recursion
weapons.desc: Time signature AR. Class trait Suppression still applies — keep targets locked while Loop replays your fire.
weapons.fireIdentity: Every sixth shot instantly replays the previous five shots at once.

weapons.name: Prophecy
weapons.desc: Time signature AR. Class trait Suppression still applies — never miss a moving enemy while the party sets up.
weapons.fireIdentity: Shots resolve half a second ahead, so they land where the target will be. Never misses a moving enemy.

weapons.name: Breacher
weapons.desc: Class trait Saturation: every pellet applies element stacks individually. A full body hit up close procs a status instantly. Shotguns are the fastest status applier and start reactions for everyone else.
weapons.fireIdentity: Pump action, tight cone, heavy stagger. Loads shell by shell so you can cancel the reload at any point.

weapons.name: Flechette
weapons.desc: Class trait Saturation: every pellet applies element stacks individually. A full body hit up close procs a status instantly. Shotguns are the fastest status applier and start reactions for everyone else.
weapons.fireIdentity: Very wide cone, very high pellet count. Useless past ten meters, instant max stacks inside it.

weapons.name: Ripper
weapons.desc: Class trait Saturation: every pellet applies element stacks individually. A full body hit up close procs a status instantly. Shotguns are the fastest status applier and start reactions for everyone else.
weapons.fireIdentity: Semi auto, fewer pellets per shot. Consecutive hits tighten the cone toward a slug.

weapons.name: Echo
weapons.desc: Time signature shotgun. Class trait Saturation still applies — pellets stack status while Aftershock records your damage.
weapons.fireIdentity: One trigger pull, three blasts. The shot repeats twice more at the same point in space, half a second apart.

weapons.name: Unmake
weapons.desc: Time signature shotgun. Class trait Saturation still applies — strip defenses while Regression reverts elites.
weapons.fireIdentity: Each pellet strips one layer of armor, shield, or buff from what it hits.

weapons.name: Shred
weapons.desc: Class trait Haste: sustained fire builds Haste stacks that raise movement and reload speed. SMGs are the only class that fires at full accuracy while sprinting or dashing.
weapons.fireIdentity: Consecutive hits on the same target stack a damage bonus. Miss and the stacks decay.

weapons.name: Splitfire
weapons.desc: Class trait Haste: sustained fire builds Haste stacks that raise movement and reload speed. SMGs are the only class that fires at full accuracy while sprinting or dashing.
weapons.fireIdentity: Two streams that converge at a fixed distance. Standing at the convergence point doubles your damage.

weapons.name: Flux
weapons.desc: Class trait Haste: sustained fire builds Haste stacks that raise movement and reload speed. SMGs are the only class that fires at full accuracy while sprinting or dashing.
weapons.fireIdentity: Damage climbs as the magazine empties. The last quarter of the mag hits hardest.

weapons.name: Tempo
weapons.desc: Time signature SMG. Class trait Haste still applies — fire rate climbs while Accelerate doubles your tempo.
weapons.fireIdentity: Fire rate climbs the longer you hold the trigger with no cap. Release and it resets to base.

weapons.name: Revenant
weapons.desc: Time signature SMG. Class trait Haste still applies — leave afterimages while Second Self mirrors your fire.
weapons.fireIdentity: Every tenth kill leaves an afterimage of you that fires one burst at the nearest enemy.

wizardry.procDesc: Damage over time that spreads to enemies standing close.

wizardry.name: Singularity

wizardry.name: Stasis Field
wizardry.desc: Time stops inside a zone. Enemies hold still; all damage dealt is stored and lands at once when the field drops.
wizardry.chargedDesc: Time stops inside a zone. Damage is stored and lands when the field drops.

wizardry.name: Rewind
wizardry.desc: Your health, ammo, and position return to what they were 5 seconds ago.
wizardry.chargedDesc: Health, ammo, and position snap back 5 seconds.

wizardry.name: Loop
wizardry.desc: Records four seconds of your fire, then replays it on its own while you do something else.
wizardry.chargedDesc: Records four seconds of your fire, then replays it on its own while you do something else.

wizardry.name: Precognition
wizardry.desc: For six seconds nothing you can see can hit you.
wizardry.chargedDesc: For six seconds nothing you can see can hit you.

wizardry.name: Aftershock
wizardry.desc: For five seconds everything you deal is recorded, then replays at the same spots three seconds later.
wizardry.chargedDesc: For five seconds everything you deal is recorded, then replays at the same spots three seconds later.

wizardry.name: Regression
wizardry.desc: Reverts every enemy in front of you to an earlier state, removing shields, armor, and elite modifiers outright.
wizardry.chargedDesc: Reverts every enemy in front of you to an earlier state, removing shields, armor, and elite modifiers outright.

wizardry.name: Accelerate
wizardry.desc: You move, shoot, and reload at double speed while the world runs normal.
wizardry.chargedDesc: You move, shoot, and reload at double speed while the world runs normal.

wizardry.name: Second Self
wizardry.desc: A time clone appears and mirrors everything you fire for eight seconds.
wizardry.chargedDesc: A time clone appears and mirrors everything you fire for eight seconds.
